method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Dow falls, S&P 500 and Nasdaq end flat as 10-year Treasury yield approaches 5.2%
Equities.reason: Rising 10-year yield toward 5.2% is a clear negative for equities via higher discount rates and funding pain; medium-high relevance as a broad-market, rate-driven headwind rather than single-stock news.

Equities.title: Treasury Selloff Eases as Oil Drops, Stocks Climb: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Easing Treasury selloff and falling oil relieve a key macro pressure on equities; positive for risk sentiment and liquidity — material but not exceptional market-moving news.

Equities.title: Stocks Waver as Oil Rally Triggers Bond Volatility: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Oil-driven risk spike feeding bond volatility is a meaningful negative for broad equities via higher yields and risk-off flows; high relevance because it ties together oil, rates and market sentiment.

Equities.title: US Stocks Selloff Stalls on Report of US-Iran Talks Over Hormuz
Equities.reason: De‑escalation reports (US‑Iran/Hormuz) reduce oil risk premium and ease a key geopolitical shock to markets; positive for equities but relevance moderated as it's a developing/rumour-driven story.

Equities.title: Stock Market News, Sept. 24, 2026: Bond Selloff Worsens, Dinging Stocks
Equities.reason: WSJ framing of a worsening bond selloff as a direct drag on stocks reinforces the dominant macro narrative (higher yields → equity pressure); high relevance as a cross‑market, broad-market signal.

Equities.title: Stock futures are little changed as Dow heads for fourth straight losing week
Equities.reason: Modest negative — sentiment/price action shows ongoing weekly weakness; relevant to near‑term equity tone but not a big structural read.

Equities.title: Asian stocks weather bond storm, oil retreats slightly
Equities.reason: Regional markets feeling strain from global bond volatility and oil moves — a cross‑market confirmation of the rates/oil headwind to equities; moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Trading Day: Rout of control
Equities.reason: Commentary capturing a rout/risk‑off episode underlines prevailing negative market dynamics (rates/oil/drivers); relevant as a narrative piece reinforcing stress in risk assets.

Equities.title: Meta’s Best Month Since 2013 Has It on Cusp of $2 Trillion Level
Equities.reason: Strong Meta performance and AI leadership is a material pro-risk, pro-growth signal for equity leadership (tech/AI) — high relevance because AI remains a dominant market-regime theme.

Equities.title: Musk says Colossus 2 data center plans to ramp up Nvidia AI chips by year-end
Equities.reason: Confirmation of accelerating demand for Nvidia AI chips supports the AI-driven tech rally and earnings outlook for the sector; positive, with medium-high relevance to equity leadership.

Equities.title: Iran says it's up to U.S. to end war as China presses for de-escalation
Equities.summary: The remarks came as the Houthis launched a new wave of missile and drone attacks at Saudi targets Friday morning.
Equities.reason: Ongoing MENA hostilities and Houthi attacks keep geopolitical/oil risk alive — a negative for market risk appetite but given simultaneous de‑escalation headlines, treated as a moderate, countervailing signal.

Rates.title: 30-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2004 as bond market rout continues
Rates.summary: U.S. Treasury yields continued their upward momentum after hitting a 19-year high on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Direct, high-signal report that long-end yields are at multi-year highs — clear bond selloff and higher-for-longer rate pricing, strongly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Global bond selloff rolls on, US 30-year yield at highest since 2004
Rates.reason: Syndicated market-wide confirmation of a global bond rout and rising US long yields — reinforces a broad negative rates regime (selloff, higher-for-longer expectations).

Rates.title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
Rates.summary: Markets expect the central bank will take a firmer hand on inflation. It's not that easy.
Rates.reason: Analytical piece linking yield spike to Fed policy complications — signals continued hawkish pricing and pressure on bond markets, negative for yields (i.e. bond prices down).

Rates.title: Analysis: Higher Treasury yields deliver a reality check on a hot, inflation-prone economy
Rates.summary: Elevated Treasury yields will complicate both Federal Reserve policy and Treasury financing.
Rates.reason: The analysis emphasizes macro and financing consequences of higher yields — important context for a higher-for-longer rates regime, negative for bonds.

Rates.title: History shows financial calamities occur when rates rise rapidly like this: 'Something always breaks'
Rates.summary: The 10-year Treasury note yield is spiking to levels not seen in years, and that may be a bad omen for financial markets.
Rates.reason: Narrative piece warning of stress from rapid rate moves — signals downside risk to fixed income and potential systemic spillovers, negative for bonds (higher yields).

Rates.title: Philadelphia Fed's Anna Paulson says 'modest' rate moves likely ahead to tame inflation
Rates.summary: The policymaker said she and her colleagues may need to raise interest rates further to bring inflation back to target.
Rates.reason: Direct central-bank official signalling more rate hikes — increases the odds of higher-for-longer rates, negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: Official Fed projections are a primary input for market rate expectations; hawkish/path showing slower disinflation or higher path for rates materially supports the current selloff — strongly negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Why investors aren’t buying yet another attempt by the Treasury to calm the rattled bond market
Rates.reason: Reports on Treasury efforts to intervene and market skepticism — signals ongoing technical stress/liquidity issues in the bond market, modestly negative.

Rates.title: Treasury Rout Threatens Popular EM Carry Trade as Citi Pulls Back
Rates.reason: Shows cross-border transmission: US yield surge reverses carry trades and reduces demand for EM assets — highlights broader market impact of higher US yields, negative for global bonds/flows.

Rates.title: 30-year fixed mortgage rate jumps sharply Thursday to 7.45%
Rates.summary: The 30-year fixed rate surged to 7.45%, the highest level since April 2024 as bonds sold off and yields rose.
Rates.reason: Mortgage-rate transmission from the Treasury/bond selloff — real-economy impact of higher yields, negative for fixed-income sensitivity sectors.

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paus
Rates.reason: BoE notice on unwinding gilt stock (QT) increases supply/puts upward pressure on yields in gilts — direct, policy-driven negative for UK fixed income.

FX.title: Euro: Volatility divergence points to future swings against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur highlights that EUR/USD realized 3-month volatility has dropped to near five-year lows. He links part of the calm to highly correlated central bank rate expectations driven partly by oil prices, but notes this cannot fully explain th
FX.reason: EUR-focused volatility note with limited immediate directional implication. Signals potential for future EUR/USD swings (non-USD strength bias), but low immediacy — small positive direction and low relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens amid falling oil prices, stronger US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its gains for the fifth consecutive day, trading around 1.4140 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) faces downward pressure from falling crude oil prices.
FX.reason: Clear FX-native story linking CAD weakness to falling oil and broad USD strength. High relevance for USD/CAD flows and commodity-linked FX dynamics; direction negative because USD strength hurts non-USD (CAD).

FX.title: Canadian Dollar declines amid hawkish Fed outlook, US–Iran deal hopes
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair gathers strength to around 1.4150 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Mounting bets on further Federal ‌Reserve (Fed) rate hikes provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Canadian Dollar (CAD).
FX.reason: Reinforces USD-strength/vs-CAD narrative driven by hawkish Fed bets. Slightly lower relevance than the oil-linked piece (overlap/redundancy) but still market-relevant for FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen gains amid intervention watch as JGB 10-year yield hits 30-year highs
FX.summary: USD/JPY halts its five-day winning streak, trading around 158.10 during Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair depreciates as the Japanese Yen (JPY) gathers support. Market participants are remaining on high alert, anticipating potential market intervention
FX.reason: JPY-specific move with intervention watch and high JGB yields—highly FX-relevant. Direction positive (non-USD/JPY strength), relevance elevated because intervention risk can drive outsized FX flows and volatility.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Heads for second week of gain above 101.00, upside bias intact
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.15 in the early European trading hours on Friday.
FX.reason: DXY-focused piece showing sustained USD strength — core market/regime signal for FX. Strong negative direction (USD strength is negative for non-USD currency pairs) and high relevance given cross-pair transmission.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Key trigger is RBA’s policy on Tuesday
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after a vertical sell-off in the last two trading days. In the European trade, the Aussie pair is slightly higher to near 0.7020 after finding cushion at around 0.7000.
FX.reason: AUD note tied to an upcoming RBA policy decision — event-driven but currently low immediate directional conviction vs dominant USD theme. Small positive for AUD, moderate relevance due to policy event.

FX.title: Euro posts modest lossess on rising Fed hike odds, Middle East tensions
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades with mild losses near 1.1375 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Euro (EUR) amid hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve (Fed) officials and a lack of progress between the US-Iran
FX.reason: Direct EUR/USD move tied to hawkish Fed signals and geopolitical risk — reinforces USD strength narrative versus the euro. Medium-high relevance for EUR flows.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: At make or a break near 1.1350
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower at around 1.1375 against the US Dollar (USD) in the early European trade on Friday, but is inside Thursday’s trading range. The major currency pair is broadly under pressure as the US Dollar (USD) outperforms across the b
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing EUR under pressure as USD outperforms. Lower relevance due to technical focus, but direction aligns with prevailing USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Softens to near 1.3200, staying bearish under 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.3210 during the early European session on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) amid growing domestic fiscal concerns ahead of the upcoming UK budget.
FX.reason: GBP weakness vs USD tied to domestic fiscal concerns — relevant for GBP/USD flows. Direction negative reflecting non-USD currency weakness; relevance elevated due to fiscal policy transmission.

FX.title: Indian Rupee draws temporary support from RBI’s likely intervention
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains a temporary ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after remaining under pressure in the past few days. The USD/INR pair struggles to extend gains above 95.96 on the likely Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) intervention.
FX.reason: EMFX/intervention story: RBI intervention expectations provide temporary INR support versus USD. Positive for INR (non-USD) but limited by 'temporary' language — moderate relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar remains depressed around 0.5650, near June lows vs bullish USD
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair attracts sellers for the third straight day, flirting with its lowest level since late June, around mid-0.5600s during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices remain on track to register losses for the fifth straight week and seem vulnerable
FX.reason: Clear NZD weakness narrative versus a bullish USD — relevant for EM/high-beta currency flows and consistent with the broader USD-strength regime.

FX.title: Japanese Yen recovers from three-week low vs USD amid looming intervention risk
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair drifts lower during the Asian session on Friday, stalling its recent strong move up to a three-week high, near the 159.00 mark, touched the previous day.
FX.reason: JPY-specific recovery with explicit intervention risk; high FX relevance because intervention can abruptly change USD/JPY flows. Positive direction for JPY (non-USD).

FX.title: Japanese Yen keeps sliding as Tokyo repeats its warning and holds fire
FX.summary: Finance Minister Katayama said on Thursday that the principles behind the joint US-Japan intervention of July 31 are still alive, and USD/JPY went on to touch 159.00, its highest since early September. The pair is trading just under 159.00, on track for a fift
FX.reason: Contrasting JPY weakness piece showing USD/JPY at multi-week highs and Tokyo holding fire despite warnings. High relevance because it signals ongoing yen volatility and potential for policy action; direction negative (USD strength hurts JPY).

FX.title: Australian Dollar flatlines near 0.7000 as traders assess Trump-Xi summit
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair holds steady around 0.7010 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding the US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping summit at the White House.
FX.reason: Neutral/sideways AUD note tied to geopolitics; limited immediate FX transmission. Small positive assigned to reflect slight AUD stability vs dominant USD narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD holds below $64.00 amid Fed hiking bets, higher yields
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) is trading sideways on Friday, with upside attempts capped below $64.00, on track for a 3.7% weekly decline, and with bears looking at the bottom of the monthly trading range, at $62.30.
Commodities.reason: Silver pressured by Fed hiking expectations and higher real yields; metal sensitive to USD/yield backdrop so this is a direct negative for the silver market.

Commodities.title: Gold consolidates below $4,300 as hawkish Fed, higher bond yields and bullish USD weigh
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its consolidative price move through the Asian session on Friday and languishes near the weekly low set the previous day amid a bearish fundamental backdrop.
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed, higher bond yields and a stronger USD are the dominant drivers capping gold — clear negative for the precious-metal complex with moderate-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for weekly loss as stronger dollar, Fed rate outlook weighs
Commodities.reason: Authoritative confirmation that the market-wide driver (stronger USD and Fed rate outlook) is forcing a weekly gold loss — high-relevance negative for gold and related commodities.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Slips below $92.00 amid Iran diplomacy hopes; bullish potential intact
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – extends the previous day's late pullback from the $95.80 area and drifts lower through the Asian session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Iran diplomacy/truce hopes are reducing the Middle East risk premium and pushing WTI lower — a clear negative oil-price impulse with meaningful relevance to energy markets.

Commodities.title: Oil slides as US-Iran truce hopes outweigh Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
Commodities.reason: Market reacting to reduced geopolitical risk (US-Iran truce hopes) which is lowering oil risk premia — near-term negative for crude prices, though tail risks remain.

Commodities.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
Commodities.summary: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
Commodities.reason: Added U.S. liquefaction/export capacity increases gas export demand, supportive for U.S. natural gas fundamentals and distillates over time — modestly bullish for the gas complex.

Commodities.title: What goes into diesel prices?
Commodities.summary: The price of distillate fuel oil, often sold as diesel, is driven by the price of crude oil, retail margins, distribution costs, taxes, and crack spreads, the indicator we use for refining margins. Tight global supplies of distillate fuel oil and elevated crud
Commodities.reason: EIA note that tight distillate supplies and strong crude/crack spreads support diesel prices — a constructive signal for refined product margins and a modest positive for the oil complex.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.reason: Official Fed move toward a supervisory framework for payment stablecoins is a major regulatory-clarity event that materially supports institutional adoption and stablecoin integration into payments — positive for crypto ecosystem and on-ramps.

Crypto.title: Fed Unveils More Stablecoin Plans as Regulators Embrace Crypto
Crypto.reason: Major financial press highlighting expanded Fed stablecoin plans reinforces the narrative of regulatory legitimation and broadens market impact beyond crypto-native outlets — supportive for adoption and flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
Crypto.reason: Crypto-focused coverage of the Fed's GENIUS Act implementation highlights direct implications for stablecoin issuers and market plumbing — net positive for payments and regulated stablecoin issuance prospects.

Crypto.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
Crypto.reason: CFTC guidance enabling commodities firms to use tokenized assets and blockchain records materially expands institutional use-cases and legitimizes tokenization in regulated markets — strong structural positive for crypto tokenization adoption.

Crypto.title: UK’s largest banks complete world’s first interbank transactions using tokenized deposits
Crypto.reason: Major banks running interbank transactions with tokenized deposits is clear institutional adoption of blockchain rails and supports the broader narrative that tokenization is moving from pilot to production — positive for crypto infrastructure demand.

Crypto.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
Crypto.reason: High-profile asset manager tokenizing a venture fund (with prominent AI stakes) signals demand for tokenized securities and broadens the investor base — supportive for crypto-native tokenization use-cases.

Crypto.title: Solana Foundation hires Binance, Polygon veterans as it ramps up tokenized finance push
Crypto.reason: Solana strengthening teams to push tokenized finance underscores platform-level competition to capture tokenization flows — incremental positive for ecosystem growth and activity on L1s.

Crypto.title: EU's financial regulator to make AI and tokenization a supervisory priority in 2027
Crypto.reason: EU regulators prioritizing tokenization and AI signals proactive supervision and potential rulemaking that legitimizes tokenized markets — generally supportive for long-term institutional integration, though increased oversight may bring transitional costs.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
Crypto.reason: Large exchange hack (~$352M) is a significant negative shock to market trust, liquidity and counterparty risk; raises short-term outflows and regulatory scrutiny for exchanges and custodial models.

Crypto.title: Crypto platform Bitget suspects North Korea is responsible for $352 million hack
Crypto.reason: Attribution to a state-backed actor (North Korea) adds a geopolitical/cybersecurity dimension that increases systemic risk concerns and could prompt stronger regulatory and sanctions responses — negative for market sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gray Chen says
Crypto.reason: Operator/process failure (spoofed transfers) rather than compromise of on-chain private keys reduces some systemic crypto-native contagion risk but still highlights exchange operational vulnerabilities — modestly negative.

Crypto.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
Crypto.reason: Another hot-wallet hack (smaller scale) reinforces recurring security incidents for custodial services, contributing to cautious sentiment around exchange custody and hot-wallet practices.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin just topped a key long-term moving average. Here's what it might mean
Crypto.reason: Technical breakout signal may support near-term bullish momentum for Bitcoin, but as a TA piece it has limited structural relevance compared with regulatory and adoption developments.

Crypto.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
Crypto.reason: Regulatory watchdogs flagging quantum threats to encryption is a negative tech risk for crypto infrastructure and could accelerate migration efforts — longer-term structural concern with modest immediate market impact.
